verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage says it can "screen customers and disposition alerts" for onboarding, ongoing monitoring and ad-hoc investigations, which is a first-party but thin claim of screening. The rest of the evidence covers case management and ingesting alerts from external monitoring systems, not native list screening. missing for 10: explicit sanctions/watchlist screening, ability to select specific lists, screening of both individuals and companies, list sources/coverage documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
